turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I got a small bonus at work and I don't want to just blow it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice! You could put it toward your credit card balance or start an emergency fund. Which matters more to you right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a bit, my kid needs me. I'll come back to you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you know how long it takes to get downtown at nine in the morning?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: With traffic? At least forty minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh wow. My interview is at nine thirty.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then leave by eight, and grab a coffee nearby if you're early.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good idea. Can I borrow your nice umbrella too? It's supposed to rain.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Of course. Showing up soaked is not the look.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Have you thought about the bonus, paying off the card or building a cushion?
